gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8516 electric heating resistors; Section XVII note 2(f) removes ch.85 equipment from aircraft parts 8807
GRI 6: 8516.80.40 resistors assembled only with simple insulated former and connections for anti-icing or deicing

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVII note 2(f) excludes chapter 85 electrical equipment

missing_facts: heating element only or system with controls
classification.rationale: Heading 8516 covers electric heating resistors, and subheading 8516.80.40 names anti-icing or deicing use. Section XVII note 2(f) bars 8807. If sold as a system with controls, 8516.80.80 may apply.
